pages.text: This chapter introduces various symptoms. Symptoms are usually harmless and serve as indicators of your physical condition.

pages.title: Intense Pain
pages.text: Intense pain may indicate dislocation or fracture.

pages.title: Sweating
pages.text: Sweating may indicate moderate withdrawal symptoms.

pages.title: Craving
pages.text: Craving may indicate mild withdrawal symptoms.

pages.title: Staggering
pages.text: Staggering may indicate leg dislocation, fracture, or unremoved bandages or casts.

pages.title: Pale Skin
pages.text: Pale skin may indicate severe blood loss.

pages.title: Difficulty Breathing
pages.text: Difficulty breathing may indicate hypoxia or respiratory arrest.

pages.title: Nausea
pages.text: In this mod, nausea may indicate severe withdrawal symptoms.

pages.title: Blindness
pages.text: In this mod, blindness may indicate severe hypoxia.

pages.title: Weakness
pages.text: In this mod, weakness may indicate severe blood loss.
